source: A real capture (2026-10-31, RyzenShine): the Keychron Link-KM dongle 3434:d026 with a Keychron mouse on 2.4 GHz, its vendor node (interface 1, usage page 0xFFC1). Nothing came by itself in 20 s; each status request (report 0xB3, command 0x06) was answered within milliseconds with report 0xB4, the DPI stages 400 to 5000 at bytes 6 to 15 and the percent (94) at byte 20.
